shared_contract.identity: A plain fixture identity leaves route path semantics visible.
shared_contract.navigation: Every document repeats the same five literal destinations in the same order.
shared_contract.truth: The fixture makes no public claim beyond its own route structure.
shared_contract.accessibility: Semantic navigation and main landmarks remain available without scripts.
shared_contract.voice: Labels name path forms directly and do not stand in for cultural review.
shared_contract.performance: Static UTF-8 documents use no scripts, remote assets, or runtime data.

routes.title: Root route
routes.user_job: Enter the fixture and reach every declared path.
routes.creative_logic: A neutral index exposes literal route behavior without prescribing a visual treatment.

observable_decisions.decision: Use literal links to every declared route.
observable_decisions.reason: The link graph can prove direct destinations without runtime inference.

routes.responsive_result: The document remains a normal reading flow at both chosen widths.
routes.no_javascript_result: All content and links are source-visible.

routes.title: Case-preserving route
routes.user_job: Verify that route case is not folded into a lowercase recipe.

observable_decisions.decision: Keep the source directory and declared path case aligned.
observable_decisions.reason: Case can be significant on the deployed filesystem.

routes.responsive_result: The route uses the fixture's normal reading flow.
routes.no_javascript_result: All content and links are source-visible.

routes.title: Unicode route
routes.user_job: Verify a safe localized UTF-8 path without transliteration.
routes.creative_logic: Keep the supplied localized path as route evidence, not as raster decoration.

observable_decisions.decision: Use the UTF-8 directory name and literal IRI path.
observable_decisions.reason: Localized paths are valid route material.

routes.responsive_result: The route uses the fixture's normal reading flow.
routes.no_javascript_result: All content and links are source-visible.

routes.title: Underscore route
routes.user_job: Verify that an underscore is preserved in a safe route segment.
routes.creative_logic: Keep the declared underscore instead of converting it to a preferred slug style.

observable_decisions.reason: The audit should inspect the project's route rather than rename it.

routes.responsive_result: The route uses the fixture's normal reading flow.
routes.no_javascript_result: All content and links are source-visible.

routes.title: Extension-bearing route
routes.user_job: Verify that a real filename route is not rewritten as a directory route.
routes.creative_logic: Preserve the extension-bearing destination exactly as the project serves it.

observable_decisions.decision: Resolve about.html as the declared destination.
observable_decisions.reason: Rewriting it to about/index.html would assert a route that does not exist.

routes.responsive_result: The route uses the fixture's normal reading flow.
routes.no_javascript_result: All content and links are source-visible.
